description: This source file contains a test case class 'GccTests' that verifies the proper relocation of the GCC compiler within a build environment, ensuring it does not retain hard-coded paths after installation. The test uses methods from the 'OESDKTestCase' base class and performs filesystem path validation and command execution.

classes.name: GccTests
classes.description: A test case class that verifies the GCC compiler's installation path and configuration within the SDK environment.

methods.name: test_verify_specs(self)
methods.description: Checks that the GCC compiler has been relocated properly by comparing its path to the SDK base directory and verifying that the SDK path does not appear in the output of 'gcc -dumpspecs'.
